name: A Dark Threat Looms
objectiveText: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the Disarming Mixture to prevent an explosion. Disarming Mixture (Provided)  ( 1 )

replies: I dove straight down from the U, like instructed, and had no problem finding the barrel. Thanks for the great directions!
about jumping in at the U in the dam name
Perfect instructions; give this man a gold star.

comments.body: coordinates 50, 14
Located around 51, 14 at the bottom of the dam. It's a small brown keg that can be hard to see, I had to swim around several times before I noticed it. It's slightly hidden in a corner.
51,14 right in the corner

Soon as you get the quest, turn around and jump off the edge of the dam.  Swim eastwardly till you spot the barrel.  Mix it, no problem.

The only possible problem you might have is that there are a ton of those stupid frenzy's around and they will try and tag you.  Best plan is to clear the area real quick, because the last thing you want to do is get 90% done with the barrel, get interrupted, fight, then stop mid battle and swim for air.
sitting on the bottom of the loch, just to the right of midline hiding in the corner. good luck
Jump in by the third cannon, the one farthest north. It's very nearly right below it.

replies: That's the keg you have to find to complete the first quest in the chain; chances of it also completing the chain are minimal ;)

in a crook in the wall on the bottom. not too bad.  had to swim around three times though before i saw it. follow the wall exactly after u jump in mid span and swim east
The barrel is at (51,14)
Btw, by "base of the dam" they mean the south side...not the north. If you go to the north you have a very long walk back..hah

Ok the Keg, is at the foot of the damn.  Its more to the East side, unless spawn location is random.  It can be hard to locate if everyone is doing the quest atm.  Just be patient it will respawn.  Best thing to do is probably camp a visible location and see if a keg spawns.  Thats your target.

comments.body: From the big tree trunk on the bottom follow the wall of the dam eastly. The corner is close by but cannot be seen from the trunk.
